title: The Doctor Who Injected 200 Patients with Liquid Mercury
hook: He claimed mercury injections cured syphilis. Instead, it destroyed their nervous systems—and he got a medical award.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer grotesqueness of liquid mercury being injected paired with historical malpractice creates morbid curiosity.

title: The 'Morning Sickness Pill' That Gave 10,000 Babies No Arms
hook: A drug prescribed to millions of pregnant women caused phocomelia in thousands of newborns. The company hid the data for 5 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Thalidomide is known, but reframing it as a 'morning sickness pill' and focusing on the cover-up makes it fresh and horrifying.

title: The Surgeon Who Removed Healthy Organs for 'Practice'
hook: This surgeon removed kidneys, spleens, and gallbladders from patients who never needed surgery—just to stay sharp.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that a doctor would treat you as a practice dummy is a primal surgical fear.

title: The Hospital That Painted Over Black Mold and Called It Clean
hook: A hospital painted over toxic black mold for 15 years. 200 patients died from lung infections. The CEO got a bonus.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visual of painting over toxic mold combined with corporate profit motive is a vivid, anger-inducing story.

title: The Clinical Trial That Gave Patients Ground Glass Instead of Medicine
hook: A pharmaceutical company filled their 'miracle drug' capsules with crushed glass. Patients' throats bled for months.
why_this_can_go_viral: The physical sensation of swallowing glass is viscerally horrifying, making it instantly shareable.

title: The CDC Covered Up That a Vaccine Gave 5,000 Kids Narcolepsy
hook: The swine flu vaccine triggered narcolepsy in thousands of children. The CDC buried the data for 3 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Narcolepsy is a bizarre, dramatic side effect (falling asleep mid-sentence) that makes the story highly visual and memeable.

title: The Doctor Who Sold HIV-Infected Bone Grafts to 500 Hospitals
hook: He harvested bone from HIV-positive cadavers and sold it as 'sterile' grafts. 500 hospitals bought it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a donated bone giving you HIV combines medical horror and trust betrayal.

title: The Suppressed $3 Cream That Reversed 100% of Psoriasis in Trials
hook: A cheap topical cream cured severe psoriasis in every single trial patient. The patent was bought and locked in a vault.
why_this_can_go_viral: Chronic skin conditions are incredibly common; the idea of a cheap cure being hidden feeds massive audience anger.

title: The 'Flu Shot' That Was Actually a Live Anthrax Injection
hook: A batch of 'flu vaccines' contained live anthrax spores. 200 people got sick. The company blamed 'labeling error.'
why_this_can_go_viral: The word 'anthrax' triggers immediate fear, and the idea of getting it from a 'safe' flu shot is nightmare fuel.

title: The Hospital That Let a Patient Rot in Bed for 40 Days
hook: A patient was left in the same bed for 40 days. His sheets fused to his skin. The staff just walked past every day.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visceral imagery of a human being decaying while alive in a hospital is unforgettable.

title: The Eye Surgeon Who Used Industrial-Grade Superglue on Corneas
hook: To save money, this surgeon used hardware-store superglue on patients' eyes. Several went permanently blind.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visual of superglue being dropped into an open eye is a sensory trigger that makes people wince and share.

title: The Vitamin Company That Sold Arsenic as 'Mineral Supplement'
hook: A top-selling 'mineral supplement' was almost pure arsenic. The CEO claimed it was 'naturally occurring.'
why_this_can_go_viral: The word 'arsenic' is universally known as poison, making the cognitive dissonance with 'mineral supplement' extremely shareable.

title: The Doctor Who Prescribed Chemo for 20 Years to a Healthy Patient
hook: A woman went to chemotherapy every month for 20 years. She never had cancer. The doctor just wanted her insurance payments.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer duration—20 years of unnecessary chemo—is a mind-blowing scale of evil.

title: The Clinical Trial That Injected Patients with Grinded Fetal Tissue
hook: A biotech company injected Parkinson's patients with ground-up fetal brain tissue. The results were kept secret.
why_this_can_go_viral: The biological and ethical shock value of fetal tissue injection creates strong emotional reaction.

title: The Hospital That Dumped Surgical Waste in a Children's Playground
hook: For years, a hospital dumped bloody surgical waste into a dumpster next to a park. Kids played near infected needles.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of children playing near biohazard waste is a powerful emotional trigger that drives outrage.

title: The 'Miracle Diabetes Drug' That Caused Patients' Bladders to Explode
hook: A blockbuster diabetes drug caused patients' bladders to rupture spontaneously. The FDA ignored 1,500 internal reports.
why_this_can_go_viral: The phrase 'bladder explode' is so visceral and shocking that it guarantees pause-and-click.

title: The Doctor Who Deliberately Gave Patients Mad Cow Disease
hook: This doctor used growth hormone harvested from cadavers with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease. Dozens died slow brain deaths.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mad Cow disease is already terrifying; the idea of it being deliberately injected is deeply unsettling.

title: The 'Allergy Shot' That Was 100% Industrial Bleach
hook: A clinic gave patients 'allergy desensitization shots' that were just bleach. 50 patients died from internal chemical burns.
why_this_can_go_viral: Bleach is universally known as a poison; injecting it is a level of insanity that demands to be seen.
